scope: Changed/new Python runtime, core, packaging, CI, and tests/test_*.py publication-scope review; not an architecture or release-readiness re-audit.
result: No confirmed publication blockers found within the reviewed scope.

checks.name: Candidate source inventory and full-text scanning
checks.evidence: Combined the supplied changed/new NUL path manifests and selected the assigned scope. Read 67 current public source files, including unchanged config.py for context, using raw reads after normal reads summarized long files. Credential/debug/path grep passes completed without truncated matches. No DB, credential file, runtime directory, or historical result content was read.

checks.name: Credential-shaped literals and private artifacts
checks.evidence: Scanned private-key headers, common cloud/GitHub/API token prefixes, credential assignments, authenticated URLs, workstation paths, private host indicators, and debug hooks. No confirmed live credential, private-key block, workstation path, private-host literal, or debug breakpoint was found in the current reviewed sources. Credential-shaped test values were classified using their fixture/monkeypatch/assertion context, not as live secrets.

checks.name: Fixture false-positive classification
checks.evidence: tests/test_commercial_readiness.py:109,120 contains an explicitly synthetic credential used to assert CLI non-disclosure. tests/test_pi_orchestrator_web.py:16 triggered a token-prefix substring scan inside a task-related HTML data attribute, not a credential. CI database passwords and authenticated loopback database URLs belong to ephemeral service fixtures. Other test credentials are synthetic fixture or redaction-test inputs. Values intentionally omitted.

checks.name: New diagnostic output and exposed fields
checks.evidence: Reviewed the changed diagnostic and runtime diff plus surrounding source. diagnostics.py limits accepted fields to identifiers and scalar measurements; agent/llm.py additions record bounded metadata rather than prompt/response bodies; forge/executor.py logs exception class rather than raw driver details. agent/audit.py's new projection selects identifiers, statuses, counts, timing and model revision, not SQL, result rows, model input, or raw exception text. No accidental payload debug output was identified in these additions.

checks.name: Dependency and package resource exposure
checks.evidence: Reviewed pyproject.toml, the Python 3.11 constraint file, resource consumers, and scripts/package_smoke.py. Dependency declarations contain package requirements, not private indexes, credential-bearing URLs, local paths, or direct private VCS references. diagnostics is listed as a distributable module. Contract JSON resources and PoC templates are explicitly included; the changed/new packaged files are schemas, synthetic fixtures and templates. Narrow resource inventories completed for agent/contracts/*.json and forge/templates/poc/**/*; no private artifact was identified in the changed resource set.

checks.name: CI and relocation references
checks.evidence: The CI workflow references the present constraints/ci-python311.txt and scripts/package_smoke.py, retains the existing tests/test_database_compatibility.py target, and exercises wheel/sdist installation from an external temporary working directory. The smoke script checks required resources and rejects chart directories, database files, forge.yaml and .env archive members. PoC loading uses importlib.resources instead of the removed top-level customer-poc-template path. No obsolete tests/accuracy, tests/text-to-sql-failures, scripts/seed_mock_data, or customer-poc-template references were found in the reviewed current Python/CI sources. Existing tests/datasets references were not mistaken for relocated manual benchmark paths.

limits: This is a static publication-scope scan, not a guarantee that arbitrary opaque strings are harmless or a full application security audit.

No project test suite, package build/install, model call, dependency-index lookup, database query, or real runtime configuration access was performed. Previously reported local verification was accepted rather than repeated.

Built wheel/sdist contents were not independently regenerated or inspected; package resource and exclusion conclusions are limited to reviewed source declarations and the committed smoke-check logic. Parent owns final publication verification.

The first broad package glob unexpectedly applied a 200-result cap despite a larger requested limit and included nested same-name directories. It was reported to tool QA and was not used as proof of a complete inventory; narrow resource globs were used instead.
Manual benchmark trees, historical reports, original result runs, real datasets/configuration, and nonassigned Web/Pi/tooling files were excluded or left to their assigned reviewers.

Pre-existing logging outside the changed diagnostic additions was not re-audited as a general refactor/security project. The absence of accidental new payload logging does not certify every existing runtime log path.
No source or documentation edits, staging, commits, pushes, merges, tags, releases, or deployment actions were performed. The only requested deliverable written is this temporary audit report.
